last_review.summary: The diff is confined to new files under src/core/, correctly extends the existing AppClient authentication seam, exports a stable Nest injection token, and provides an injectable deterministic Noop strategy returning no credentials. No network behavior, secrets, business logic, database changes, or out-of-scope architecture were introduced. Build and Prisma validation passed.
